d: The team searches for the daughter of a geneticist  Amita and Charlie talk about having kids  a dark secret is revealed.
The body of a dead woman turns up at a decommissioned air base where spooky things have been happening.
The team tries to locate a cybercrime lord with an undercover sting, but a brilliant hacker foils the operation.
Agent Ian Edgerton (Lou Diamond Phillips) is the prime suspect in a murder when the informant he met with winds up dead, and his desperation puts a member of Don's team at risk.
When robbers strike a diamond exchange and take hostages, the team thinks the culprits are copying a convict's criminal strategies.
The team calls Agent Roger Bloom for help when money from the D.B. Cooper heist is recovered.
Don and the team investigate the theft of scratch-off lottery tickets.
A lost shipment of high-caliber firearms links to murders across the city  Amita and Charlie disagree on a wedding date.
